lastCompletedStory.title: Wire model resolution into the loop.ts implementer dispatch

nextStoryContext: src/supervisor/loop.ts's implementer dispatch call site now calls resolvePhaseModel({ phase: 'implementer', backend: implBackend, cacheReader: opts.codexModelsCacheReaderFn }) instead of readPhaseModel('implementer', undefined, implBackend), replacing the raw model read with the US-003 fail-closed decision fn. A new RunSupervisorOptions.codexModelsCacheReaderFn?: CodexModelsCacheReader field (mirrors codexAuthCheckFn) is the injectable seam for resolvePhaseModel's cacheReader; when absent, resolvePhaseModel's own default parameter (readCodexModelsCache) is used, since the call site passes opts.codexModelsCacheReaderFn straight through (an explicit undefined value still triggers the destructuring default inside resolvePhaseModel, no ?? needed). A NOT-ok resolution aborts BEFORE the argv build (buildSpawnArgv), mirroring the existing codexAuthPreflight abort block verbatim: blocked lastOutcome with a 'model-resolution-failed: <message> (advisory <storyId>)' detail, iterations++, fire-and-forget escalateFn, finishTerminal('blocked'), early return -- this is a NEW, EARLIER abort point than codexAuthPreflight (which still runs unchanged, immediately before respawn-pane, unreordered relative to buildSpawnArgv per AC1). Only the implementer dispatch site was wired in this story; the other 3 supervisor dispatch call sites that still call readPhaseModel directly (reviewer in review.ts, planner+auditor in plan-runner.ts) plus the run.ts orchestrator site were explicitly out of scope (this story's AC only names loop.ts) and remain candidates for a follow-up story if the same auto-resolve-then-abort wiring is wanted there too. loop.ts crossed its file-size ceiling (2586->2633, content.split('\n').length); raised in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a tracker-ref-carrying _ref entry, staged before the check:all re-run per the ratchet-gate rubric.

officialDocsValidated.summary: This story wires the already-built (US-003) resolvePhaseModel decision fn into one existing loop.ts call site; no new external library or documented API surface was introduced. US-001/US-002's Step 5.5 fetches (Claude Code model-config docs, openai/codex protocol source) already cover the vocabulary this wiring reuses.
